FAQ
When is the gym open?

24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

How do I join?

Call (763) 295-4194 or stop in. The owners are often on site.

Do you offer short-term memberships?

A summer membership has been offered before. Call and ask about current options.

What equipment do you have?

Rogue and Hammer Strength, plenty of squat racks and deadlift stations, machines, cables, free weights and cardio.

Do you sell supplements?

Yes. Protein, pre-workout and creatine are sold inside the gym.

Is the gym accessible?

Yes, wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking and restroom.
